title: Corporate Password Policy
text: All corporate accounts must use passwords of at least 12 characters that combine uppercase letters, lowercase letters, numbers and symbols. Passwords are renewed every 90 days and the last five passwords cannot be reused. Sharing credentials by email or messaging is prohibited. Employees are encouraged to use the password manager approved by the security team.

title: New Employee Onboarding Process
text: The onboarding process starts when Human Resources registers the new employee in the system. IT creates the email account, assigns the computer and delivers the access credentials. The direct manager schedules the orientation and assigns a mentor for the first two weeks.

title: Employee Offboarding and Access Revocation Process
text: When an employee leaves the company, Human Resources notifies IT the same day. Email, VPN and internal system accounts are disabled and the computer is recovered. The direct manager backs up relevant information and transfers pending responsibilities.

title: Acceptable Use Policy for Equipment and Software
text: Company equipment is used exclusively for work activities. Only software approved by IT with a valid license may be installed. Downloading programs from unknown sources and connecting external storage devices without authorization is prohibited.

title: Vacation Request Procedure
text: Employees request vacation through the Human Resources portal at least 15 days in advance. The direct manager approves or rejects the request within three business days. Approved vacations appear in the team calendar.

title: Travel Expense Reimbursement Policy
text: Authorized travel expenses are reimbursed when receipts are submitted within 10 days after returning. Transportation, lodging and meals are covered within the limits set by the expense table. Expenses without receipts or without prior authorization will not be reimbursed.

title: System Change Management Process
text: Every change to production systems requires a documented change request, risk assessment and approval from the change committee. Changes are scheduled in defined maintenance windows and must include a rollback plan. After implementation the system is validated and the request is closed.

title: Backup and Data Retention Policy
text: Critical servers and databases are backed up daily and backups are kept for 90 days. A monthly copy is stored off-site for one year. IT performs quarterly restore tests to verify the integrity of the backups.

title: Remote Work and VPN Access Policy
text: Remote work requires authorization from the direct manager and mandatory use of the corporate VPN. Employees must have a secure connection, keep their device updated and lock the screen when away. Remote access to critical systems requires two-factor authentication.

title: Computer Equipment Procurement Process
text: Equipment purchase requests are sent to IT with justification and approval from the direct manager. Purchasing gets quotes from at least three vendors and presents the best option. The purchased equipment is recorded in the asset inventory before it is delivered to the user.

title: Information Classification Policy
text: Information is classified as public, internal, confidential or restricted. Confidential documents are shared only with authorized staff and must be stored in repositories with access control. Information owners review the assigned classification every year.

title: Incident: Email Service Outage
text: On Monday morning users reported that they could not send or receive email. The mail server had run out of disk space because of mailbox growth. IT freed up space, restarted the service and email was restored in two hours. A disk usage alert was configured.

title: Ticket: User Locked Out Due to Expired Password
text: An employee cannot log in because the password expired and the account was locked after several failed attempts. The support analyst verified the user's identity, unlocked the account and reset a temporary password. The user was asked to change it at the next login.

title: Incident: VPN Connection Failure for Remote Workers
text: Several remote employees were unable to connect to the corporate VPN. The cause was an expired certificate on the remote access server. IT renewed the certificate and installed the update. Users regained access and a reminder was created to renew certificates before they expire.

title: Ticket: Network Printer Not Responding on Second Floor
text: The second floor printer does not print and shows an offline status. The technician checked the network cable, restarted the device and updated the driver on the affected computers. The printer worked again and its assigned IP address was documented.

title: Incident: Phishing Attempt Reported by Employees
text: Several employees received a fake email pretending to be from the bank and asking for credentials. The security team blocked the sender domain, deleted the message from mailboxes and notified users. Two employees had clicked the link, so their passwords were reset.

title: Ticket: Laptop Extremely Slow and Disk Full
text: A user reports that the laptop takes several minutes to start and applications freeze. The analyst found that the disk was almost full and that there were unnecessary programs at startup. Space was freed, applications were uninstalled and more memory was added to the computer.

title: Incident: Sales Database Unavailable
text: The sales system stopped responding because the main database was unavailable after a hardware failure on the server. The secondary server was activated and the latest available backup was restored. The service was down for three hours. Replacement of the damaged hardware was scheduled.

title: Ticket: Error Installing Accounting Software Update
text: The finance department could not install the new version of the accounting software because the installer showed a permissions error. The technician granted temporary administrator privileges, ran the installation and removed the privileges. The procedure was documented for future computers.

title: Incident: Network Connectivity Loss at the North Branch
text: The north branch lost access to the internet and internal systems during the afternoon. The telecommunications provider confirmed a failure on its main link. The backup link was enabled and connectivity was restored in 40 minutes. A report was requested from the provider.

title: Ticket: Deleted File Recovery Request
text: A user accidentally deleted a shared folder with the annual budgets. The analyst located the most recent daily backup, restored the folder and verified with the user that the files were complete. The team was reminded of the backup and retention policy.

title: FAQ: How do I reset my password?
text: To reset your password go to the self-service portal and select the forgot password option. You will receive a code on your registered phone. If you cannot access it, contact the help desk with your employee number. Remember that the new password must comply with the security policy.

title: FAQ: How do I request new equipment or accessories?
text: To request equipment or accessories, open a ticket with the help desk stating the reason and get authorization from your direct manager. IT will check inventory availability or start a purchase. Delivery time depends on equipment availability.

title: FAQ: How do I check my available vacation days?
text: You can check your available vacation days in the Human Resources portal, absences section. There you will see your balance, pending requests and history. If you find an error in your balance, write to Human Resources with your employee number.

title: FAQ: What should I do if I receive a suspicious email?
text: If you receive a suspicious email do not open attachments or click on links. Forward it to the security mailbox and delete it. If you already entered your data, change your password immediately and notify the security team so they can review your account.

title: FAQ: How do I connect to the network from home?
text: To work from home install the corporate VPN client, log in with your username and confirm the second authentication factor. If the connection fails, check your internet and restart the client. If the problem persists, open a ticket with the help desk.

title: Minutes: Quarterly Information Security Review
text: The security incidents of the quarter were reviewed, including three phishing attempts and one blocked unauthorized access. It was agreed to strengthen employee training, implement two-factor authentication on all systems and update the password policy. Owner: security team.

title: Minutes: Spring Campaign Launch Planning
text: The marketing team defined the spring campaign calendar, the digital media budget and the main messages. Sales confirmed the discounts per product. A weekly follow-up meeting and a results report at the end of the campaign were agreed.

title: Minutes: Cloud Migration Project Follow-up
text: IT presented the progress of the server migration to the cloud: 60% of applications were completed. Downtime and cost risks were identified. It was agreed to schedule maintenance windows, define a rollback plan and review the monthly budget.

title: Minutes: Weekly Change Management Committee
text: The committee reviewed five change requests. The firewall update and the mail server patch were approved, and one change was rejected for lacking a rollback plan. It was reminded that every change must document risks and the maintenance window.

title: Minutes: Fourth Quarter Financial Results Review
text: Finance presented the revenue, expenses and margins of the fourth quarter. Sales exceeded the target by 8%, while travel expenses exceeded the budget. It was agreed to reinforce reimbursement controls and prepare next year's budget.
